notes.title: Upcoming Update 1.2: Living Word
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/30276b0b99a2a1d569282493f71fb310a068d4b5.png"]

Hello everyone,
We’re excited to give you a preview of what’s coming in the next major update to Bible Trivia — and it’s packed with meaningful content!

Titled Living Word, this new update marks a fresh chapter in the development of the game. Many of the features have been requested by you, our community, and others are designed to take the experience further — more rewarding, more varied, and more interactive.
New Languages
We’re expanding access to the Word. The game will officially support Japanese and Korean in the base version, including translated interface and content.
DLC Wisdom Improvements
For those who own the Wisdom DLC, two much-requested features are being added:

You’ll now be able to copy Bible verses displayed in-game to share or save.

You’ll also be able to pin your favorite verses, making it easier to revisit meaningful passages.
Daily Reward System
We’re introducing a login reward system. By simply entering the game each day, you can earn gifts — from coins and customization items to new characters.
Missions and Challenges
The update will introduce thematic missions and special challenges, rewarding you with new playable characters with their own dialogue. Completing objectives will be part of your spiritual and gameplay journey.
XP Bar and Level System
After finishing a round, you’ll now see a new experience bar. When you level up, you’ll unlock visual effects and special rewards — making your progress feel even more satisfying.
Consecutive Answer Streak Animations
Answering multiple questions correctly in a row will now trigger visual effects to reward your momentum and accuracy.
New Game Modes
The update will add a variety of new modes, each offering a unique challenge. Some modes will require special items to unlock — earned by completing a set number of books.

Game modes include:

Classic: the familiar mode with themed questions per book

Survival: one wrong answer ends the session

PvP Duel (vs. AI): quick 1v1-style question battles

Speed Mode: 10 questions in just 30 seconds

Word Mode: form biblical words from scattered letters

Timer Mode: answer as many as possible in 60 seconds
Avatar Customization
You’ll be able to unlock and equip hats, hairstyles, faces, outfits, and more to personalize your in-game character. These items can be earned through progress and special rewards.
Daily and Weekly Challenges
There will be rotating challenges with new objectives released daily and weekly. These are designed to encourage short, fun, consistent sessions with exclusive rewards.
Bible Facts and Context as Level-Up Rewards
When you level up, you’ll unlock Bible fact cards — real and inspiring information about Scripture, presented in a sliding card format.

Example:
“Did you know the longest book in the Bible is Psalms?”
[hr][/hr]
We’re working hard to make this update one of the most rewarding yet. Living Word is more than a content pack — it’s a step forward in our mission to combine learning, enjoyment, and spiritual growth through gameplay.

Stay tuned to the Steam News section for updates on the release date.

Thank you for being part of this journey.
The Word remains alive — and now more interactive than ever.

— Bible Trivia Team

notes.title: Bible Trivia: Wisdom DLC Release
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/d9797cceee753319b5d197897b562138748cb18f.jpg"]



Hey everyone!

We’ve got some amazing news to share — the brand new Wisdom DLC is out now, and it brings something that truly changes everything about the Bible Trivia experience.

📖 The full Bible is now inside the game!

That’s right. You can now read, search, and explore the entire Bible without ever leaving the game.
[hr][/hr]✨ What’s included in the Wisdom DLC?
🔹 Complete Bible access in multiple languages
Every supported language in the game now features at least 4 of the most widely-used Bible translations — carefully selected to match what players actually read and study in their faith traditions.

🔹 Quick verse search
Look up any passage you want — just type a reference like “Psalm 23” or “John 3:16” and go straight to the verse.

🔹 Verse-by-verse note system
Write your own study notes, insights, or reminders directly on any verse you read. Your personal reflections are saved and easy to revisit.

🔹 Offline access
All features work without an internet connection — perfect for personal devotion, quiet study, or travel.

🔹 Supports Windows and macOS
[hr][/hr]🙌 Why is this DLC so special?
Because now, Bible Trivia is more than just a fun quiz —
With Wisdom, it becomes a full Bible study companion.

Whether you’re reviewing a question, diving deeper into Scripture, or simply taking a moment to reflect, this DLC puts the Bible directly into your hands — inside the game.

You can now explore the Word, take notes, and study your favorite passages anytime.
[hr][/hr]
🎁 Launch price: just $1.99 USD
Grab it now on Steam and enjoy a special discount for a limited time!

👉 Click here to get the Wisdom DLC
[hr][/hr]
Thank you so much to our amazing community — this DLC was created based on your feedback and support. We hope it brings inspiration and meaning to your time with Bible Trivia.

notes.title: SMALL UPDATE. PATCH NOTES V.1.1.052
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/6198f4ab116bfc369dae6fac8911e952e7111577.png

Update Available!

Großartige Neuigkeiten! (Yes, that’s German!)


We’ve officially added support for the German language! A special thanks to the linguistic explorer CroMagnonBC, whose request echoed through time and reached the development altar. Danke schön!
The game is now also available for Mac! That’s right, Apple archaeologists, it’s your turn to dig with style.
Minor interface changes — nothing drastic, but that one button that always looked off? It’s now 27% more charming.
Fixed typos and questions that were more tangled than an ancient scroll.
Overall improvements in languages: we cleaned, polished, and even gave the dialogues a nice shine.
Reduced the game's weight a bit — now it carries fewer digital sins and runs smoother.


A Little Note on German...
Just a heads-up: I'm not German — not even a distant relative of Martin Luther! So if you spot any mistakes in the translation, please be patient and forgiving. 😅
That said, I have all the translation files neatly packed and ready. So if any brave German-speaking hero (or speaker of any other language!) wants to help improve the translations, I welcome your holy assistance! Drop me a message and join the mission. 🙌

Special Thanks
A heartfelt thank-you to CroMagnonBC and all the players who sent suggestions, reported bugs, and spread good vibes. You are the scribes of our progress!

What’s coming next?
[expand type=details expanded=false]Get your sandals and turbans ready, because the next chapters are diving even deeper into the biblical universe! We’re working on new historical eras, mysterious characters, and dialogues that will challenge both your mind and your faith. Hold onto your scrolls — exciting things are coming![/expand]

May the game now be even more fun, lightweight, and accessible — and may you find the right answer before the next plague hits.
Get ready for excavations! 🏺
